input:
Incident report INC-2291

At 02:14 UTC the payments API started returning 503 errors for about 18% of requests. The on-call engineer, Tomasz, traced it to a database connection pool that was capped at 50 after Monday's config change. He raised the cap to 200 at 02:41 and errors stopped by 02:47. No payments were lost; 1,204 requests failed and were retried by clients. Action items: add an alert on pool usage above 80% (owner: Grace, due Friday), and require a second reviewer for config changes (owner: Tomasz).
A: The payments API experienced 503 errors due to a database connection pool cap of 50 after a Monday config change. Tomasz raised the cap to 200, resolving the issue. Action items include adding an alert on pool usage above 80% (Grace, due Friday) and requiring a second reviewer for config changes (Tomasz).
B: The payments API experienced 503 errors due to a database connection pool cap of 50. Tomasz raised the cap to 200, resolving the issue. Action items include adding an alert for pool usage above 80% (Grace, due Friday) and requiring a second reviewer for config changes (Tomasz).
